end.quote: But I will enter into your house in the multitude of your mercy: I will worship in your fear toward your holy temple.

reel.caption:
A psalm to pray this Wednesday (November 25, New Calendar): Psalm 5, verses 1–8, the first of two parts.

“Listen to my words, O Lord, attend to my cry. Attend to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God: for to you, O Lord, will I pray.”

“In the morning you shall hear my voice: in the morning will I wait upon you, and will look up.” And on this Leavetaking of the Entry of the Theotokos into the Temple: “But I will enter into your house in the multitude of your mercy: I will worship in your fear toward your holy temple.”

The psalm continues next Wednesday.
